author: Kusha N M
raw:
ಉರದಲ್ಲಿ ಬಿಸಿಯಿರಲಿ ಮಸ್ತಕದಿ ಶಾಂತತೆಯು
ತಿರುಗುಮರುಗುಗಳಾಗೆ ಜೀವಗುರಿ ದೂರ
ಎರವಾದ ತಿರುವುಗಳ ದಾಟೆಸ್ಥೈರ್ಯತೆಯಿಂದ
ತರಲಿಹವು ಗುರಿಸನಿಹ ಮೂಢಮನುಜ

lines: Let there be warmth in the chest and calm in the head;
with twists and turns, the goal of life grows distant;
if you cross the borrowed turnings with steadiness,
they will bring the goal near, O deluded one.
en.bhavartha: Keep a warm heart and a cool head. Detours take us away from our goal, but crossing them steadily brings the goal within reach.
